facts.text: Victory Park, a celebrated brownfield reclamation, houses the 2001 American Airlines Center and a cluster of high‑rise hotels and towers.
Klyde Warren Park, a 5.2‑acre urban oasis, stitches together Uptown’s real‑estate buzz with Downtown Dallas’s thriving Arts District.
The Trinity River Project will reshape the river into a natural corridor, adding lakes and two cable‑stayed bridges designed by Santiago Calatrava.
Union Station’s Amtrak platform connects Downtown Dallas to Chicago and Los Angeles, making it a key rail hub.
The free M‑Line Trolley, operated by the McKinney Avenue Transit Authority, loops down St. Paul Avenue for commuters and tourists alike.
Erik Jonsson Central Library, the flagship of Dallas Public Library, sits downtown and serves as the city’s largest research hub.
